display_long_description:
PLANT. SHOOT. SURVIVE.

ZG is a VR plant defense game against zombie waves. But this time… you fight too.

🌱 Strategic Plant Defense

Grow powerful plants and combine different abilities to stop massive zombie waves. 
[media]

🪴 Rip Plants to Fight

Things getting out of control? Grab plants straight from the ground and use them in combat. Your defense becomes your weapon. 
[media]
🔫 You Are the Defense

You don't just build it, you stand in it. Blast through huge zombie hordes in intense first-person battles. 
[media]

🧟 Boss: Toilet Zombie

A massive Toilet Zombie with earth-shaking attacks and chaotic patterns. Your plants won't be enough, every bullet matters. 
[media]

Free demo with 7 playable levels! Try the full version to unlock more plants, stronger weapons, and harder challenges.

The invasion never stops growing.

Your garden is under siege.

Survive it.
